answer: Each identity must lock a stake that unlocks only after a multi-epoch delay, during which randomly assigned peers can slash it if they prove copied work or contradictory attestations. A sybil farm cannot recycle the same coins across aliases, because every persona keeps its bond frozen until the delay ends. Delayed unlock is the prism that splits one budget into immobilized slices; the ocean of locked principal and the canyon of slashed bonds make cloning identities expensive.
